title: Whole object-count accounts constrained by simultaneous grouping and reconstruction
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. The complete Sunzi unknown-number problem reconstructs one count from three remainders, then independently constrains it through all three grouping relations. A coefficient-role swap keeps one grouping valid and violates two. The source answer23 and the surviving23+105k totals are distinguished; no least-number premise or unexplained reduction loop is silently added.

design.mechanism: A shared semantic language describes one collection, repeated grouping by stated sizes, quotients/remainders, reconstruction steps and answer qualifications. Every grouping refers to the same total n and must satisfy n=mq+r with0<=r<m. Reconstruction through fixed reusable coefficient roles and direct regrouping must agree. Actual counts and explanatory clause lengths may vary; unrelated per-occurrence integers or locally redefined remainder functions are forbidden.
design.unit: The whole problem, answer, method and general rule for Sunzi suanjing volumeIII objects of unknown number. A later whole-content grammar may express other accounts under declared global grouping rules, but the source does not provide arbitrary-modulus syntax or a cipher serialization.
design.contrast: The number/calendar family primary F69M001 excludes its fixed Latin mansion-prefix topology, not simultaneous arithmetic grouping. GDT902/GDT909 remain fixed multiplication-copy/equal-width division-step models, not reopened. GDT959 string remainders are not numeric remainders. IDEA000350 relates graded constituent mixtures and alternative recipes; this new example makes one integer count survive distinct divisions and a reconstruction, with discrete congruence ambiguity rather than affine grade gauge.
design.prediction: One shared decode must make source reconstruction2*70+3*21+2*15=233 and233-210=23 agree with23mod(3,5,7)=(2,3,2). Swapping coefficient roles70and21 gives282, whose representative72has residues(0,2,2): the final grouping survives, two fail. Fresh quotient choices cannot repair those inequalities under integer remainder bounds. Conversely23+105k remains compatible absent an explicit representative/bound clause.
